text:
Sam S: Heads-up: Prospect GreenBank signed LOI in principle. Need capacity plan for POC: ~25 TPS peak text-generation, 512 token average, strict latency <250ms p95. They want reserved GPUs + autoscale burst. Can SEs draft sizing + pricing options by EOD tomorrow?

Alex K: On it. Do we know model family? Llama2-70b or mix with 13b quantized?

Miriam L: Security constraints: must pass vendor questionnaire re: VPC and KMS. For POC they want data not to leave VPC, so Private deployment preferred. That affects cost and lead time.

Joel: Quick calc: 25 TPS * 512 tokens = ~12,800 tokens/s -> ~46M tokens/hr. With batching we can get decent throughput, but latency target is tight. Suggest starting with 3 reserved A100-ish GPUs + 1 burst pool for spikes. We should produce two scenarios (conservative vs lean).

Joel: Autoscale sample config:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 6
  scale_policy: cpu_and_latency
  prewarm: 1
  burst_pool: 1
```

Sam S: Pricing ask from the buyer: committed discount tiers + monthly reservation pricing. Provide committed GPU SKU pricing + per-token overage. Miriam, does the VPC/KMS constraint change what we can offer for a POC?

Miriam L: Private deployment adds a base platform fee + infra pass-through. For a short POC we can run in their VPC using our Private control plane (no data egress), but we'll need signed ATO items. I will mark the questionnaire items that force on-prem. That will change pricing if they require on-prem.

Alex K: Performance trade: 13B quantized (int8) likely meets <250ms p95 with aggressive batching and gives much lower unit cost. Recommend dual-track for POC: baseline on 13B-quantized, fallback to 70B for quality-critical flows. Use routing policy to send short responses (<=50 tokens) to 13B. We'll need an eval set to validate quality.

Elaine: Operational note: AZ affinity matters. If reserved capacity is single-AZ and they require HA across AZs, we need either cross-AZ reservation or a hot-standby in another AZ which increases cost. Also watch spot eviction risk if we use spot for burst_pool.

Sam S: Okay. Joel, can you produce two concrete configs with estimated monthly cost and expected SLO curves?
- Conservative: 4 reserved A100 + 2 burst (safety margin)
- Lean: 2 reserved + 2 burst + aggressive batching/quantization
Include cold-start times, prewarm settings, and fallback routing. Need one-pager for procurement.

Joel: Will do. Draft by 11:30 PT tomorrow. I will include token-hour estimates, cost, and a short traffic-shape table. Also adding notes on prewarm and estimated cold-start latencies for each model size.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: POC capacity quote template created: /templates/poc_capacity_quote_v2.md

Miriam L: :thumbsup: I'll answer the KMS/VPC questions and send back the redlined security questionnaire by EOD so we can include any compliance surcharges in the quote.

Alex K: One more thought — include an optional run of our Optimize recommendations: quantization profile + batch sizing that can reduce token cost by ~30% for typical prompts. Mark it as advisory for the POC.

Sam S: Great. I'll coordinate with procurement and send the buyer a timeline. Thanks team.
